entry_rationale: Pay December 2027 AONIA. The frozen implied is 4.65, under the cash rate already on the front of the same strip.
entry_thesis: October prices rose 0.4 percent and the US two-year is 4.73, but the front of the US strip has already done the hawkish work: December SOFR implied is 4.295 against cash SOFR at 3.88. Australia has not. The frozen December 2027 AONIA implied is 4.65, below the cash rate already in the Australian strip, while the front of that strip is flat. Keep every existing pay. Add a short in December 2027 AONIA rather than chasing the US contracts that have already repriced.

events.rationale: Pay December 2027 AONIA. The frozen implied is 4.65, under the cash rate already on the front of the same strip.

invalidation: The new pay is wrong if December 2027 AONIA falls further below 4.65 while the front of the Australian strip drops back and the US December step is marked back toward an unchanged path.
